limitations: Installed execution covers seven newly added files, not the complete twelve-package collection. Old Chapter/Audio failures remain independently open.
Native Windows WebKit MSE capability skips and Auto Thumbnail initial-cell diagnostics are not playback/pixel acceptance.
Controlled DASH uses a stub SDK with real core DOM/MP4; real SDK integrations and no-plugin SDK controls remain distinct.
SDK capability records describe an available candidate but do not claim plugin loading; selected plugin attachments apply only to integration cases.
Generic installed runtime/type consumer remains core/chapter only; all module forms, devices and release readiness retain their own gates.
Initial package preparation failure is preserved; HLS packaging fix is a separate PKG-HLS-PACK-01 completion commit.
